review_notes: Downloaded exact Daily Fresh Bobo run 381 artifact. Reviewed all 44 full-render samples at 4 fps and title/spoken-subtitle transitions at 8 fps. Opening puff and pinwheel rotation are visible; a brief initial 0.0-0.125s compression/pixelation glitch clears by 0.25s. During 1.5-8.0s the pinwheel keeps rotating while Bobo tracks it; body movement is restrained but not a frozen frame. At 8.25-10.75s Bobo presents the pinwheel and points. Retimed the Piper line from 8.276s to an observed 8.5s mouth window; remeasure end from the newly rendered Piper file. Remove the prior unproven generic air/pop effect events; replace with one verified CC0 wooden-handle foley cue at 8.57s during the observed grip/presentation movement. Preserve music variant 20, gentle bell waltz. No subjective listening or lip-sync claim. Final-mix ASR step will independently verify the encoded spoken line; hold if ASR is unavailable or mismatched. Finishing workflow retry after correcting a YAML indentation issue; no draft approval or publication has occurred. Audio level correction: raise only checksum-verified recorded wood foley to a restrained -13 dBFS peak ceiling; keep splash cap unchanged and strengthen music ducking. The previous ASR attempt installed faster-whisper but returned ModuleNotFoundError; retry with python -m pip and capture diagnostics. The first repaired render showed the recorded wood cue still too low (-18.5 dBFS peak); increase only recorded wood gain to the verified -13.2 dBFS ceiling, preserve soft splash limit, and install requests so the public tiny.en ASR model can be fetched. Repaired render 5 exact-file visual review: title and spoken caption are correctly placed; CC0 wood foley peak is -13.24 dBFS, music is ducked approximately 6 dB in the effect window and about 16 dB during speech; final mix peak -4.45 dBFS, no clipping. ASR import worked but model download failed on incompatible latest huggingface_hub/fsspec; retry with pinned compatible versions. No publication approval until final-mix transcript matches 'Wind power!'. Verify the final encoded mix with the stronger free base.en ASR model; exact output must be reviewed again.
